description: GeoBolivia health and basic services dashboard is published by Ministry of Planning / GeoBolivia. The dashboard visualises territorial health indicators including infant mortality and diarrhoeal disease. Its stated coverage is Bolivia; department and municipal indicators. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Health outcomes are contextual inputs, not direct measures of hospital capacity or causal effects of infrastructure. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
